title: Place-based industrial policies in the long run
title_zh: 长期视角下的地方产业政策
authors: Stephan Heblich, Marlon Seror, Yanos Zylberberg
abstract: There is growing evidence that place-based industrial policies lead to positive economic effects. This column analyses the “Million-Rouble Plants” programme of the 1950s when the Soviet Union helped China build state-of-the-art industrial facilities. By tracking the locations that benefitted, it finds positive economic spillovers in the short and medium run. Although the Million-Rouble Plants themselves continued to thrive, the performance of other local establishments eventually declined, as increasing specialisation weakened knowledge spillovers and constrained local entrepreneurship. Policymakers may achieve more durable gains by fostering diversified local production structures that encourage knowledge spillovers, labour market resilience, and adaptation to technological and market shocks.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，地方性产业政策能够带来积极的经济效应。本文分析了20世纪50年代苏联帮助中国建设先进工业设施的“百万卢布工厂”计划。通过追踪受益地区，研究发现该计划在短期和中期内产生了正向经济溢出效应。尽管“百万卢布工厂”本身持续繁荣，但其他本地企业的绩效最终出现下滑，原因在于日益增强的专业化削弱了知识溢出效应，并限制了本地创业活力。政策制定者若想实现更持久的收益，应培育多元化的地方生产结构，以促进知识溢出、增强劳动力市场韧性，并提升应对技术与市场冲击的适应能力。

title: Higher utilisation explains the recent surge in productivity growth
title_zh: 更高的利用率解释了近期生产率增长的激增
authors: Shane Boyle, John Fernald, Huiyu Li
abstract: US labour productivity has accelerated since 2022. Output per hour grew around 2.5% per year from the end of 2022 to the start of 2026, exceeding its pre-pandemic pace by 1 percentage point. A natural conjecture is that artificial intelligence has raised production efficiency. This column argues that the data suggest otherwise. Higher utilisation – that is, more intense use of labour and capital already in place – accounts for much of the recent acceleration. AI may have contributed to the higher utilisation rate, but through strong demand and heightened uncertainty rather than through efficiency.
abstract_zh: 自2022年以来，美国劳动生产率加速增长。从2022年底到2026年初，每小时产出年均增长约2.5%，较疫情前增速高出1个百分点。一个自然的猜想是人工智能提升了生产效率。但本专栏认为，数据表明情况并非如此。更高的利用率——即对现有劳动力和资本的更密集使用——是近期生产率加速的主要原因。人工智能可能对利用率提升有所贡献，但这是通过强劲需求和不确定性加剧实现的，而非通过效率提升。

title_zh: 资金紧张：金融约束对创新企业、资源错配及全要素生产率增长的作用
authors: Bøler, Esther Ann, Moxnes, Andreas, Ulltveit-Moe, Karen Helene
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze the impact of reduced financial constraints on innovating firms' performance and access to credit using a reform that allowed firms to use patents as collateral. We develop a theoretical framework to guide the analysis and quantify the aggregate impact of reduced financial constraints on misallocation and productivity by mapping data moments, reduced form results and model counterparts. Our empirical results suggest that reduced financial constraints led to an increase in firms' capital stock and bank debt. Parameterizing the model we find quantitatively large gains in output per worker in the sectors of the economy dominated by constrained firms.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项允许企业以专利作为抵押品的改革，分析了金融约束缓解对创新企业绩效和信贷获取的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架来指导分析，并通过匹配数据矩、简化形式结果与模型对应项，量化了金融约束缓解对资源错配和生产率的总体影响。实证结果表明，金融约束缓解导致企业资本存量和银行债务增加。通过参数化模型，我们发现，在受约束企业主导的经济部门中，人均产出实现了显著的量化增长。

title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释，该框架认为债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。

title: Prime vs. Subprime: Asymmetric Information and Equilibrium Securitization in a Business Cycle Model
title_zh: 优质与次级：商业周期模型中的信息不对称与均衡证券化
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介机构之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其被贷款发起人逆向选择所付出的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。

title: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
title_zh: 哪些参照群体重要以及如何重要？基于行政数据的相对收入信息实验
authors: Xiaogeng Xu, Satu Metsälampi, Michael Kirchler, Kaisa Kotakorpi, Peter Hans Matthews, Topi Miettinen
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Received wisdom holds that income rank matters for life satisfaction, but causal evidence on the nature and impact of income comparisons is limited. We randomize individuals from a representative sample of mid-career Finns to receive personal rank information from one of several reference groups. We find strong evidence of the effect of rank information on income satisfaction, but weaker effects on life satisfaction, and some evidence of real effects in experimental and administrative data. Effects are strong in narrow reference groups and weak and insignificant in the national one. Finally, we discuss the implications for income transparency policies. (JEL D31, D63, D83, D91, I31)
abstract_zh: 普遍观点认为，收入排名对生活满意度至关重要，但关于收入比较的性质及其影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们随机选取芬兰职业生涯中期人群的代表性样本，向其提供来自多个参照组之一的个人排名信息。研究发现，排名信息对收入满意度具有显著影响，但对生活满意度的影响较弱；实验数据与行政数据均显示存在部分实际效应。该效应在狭窄参照组中表现强烈，而在全国性参照组中则微弱且不显著。最后，我们探讨了该发现对收入透明度政策的启示。（JEL分类号：D31, D63, D83, D91, I31）

abstract: Abstract I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.

title: Extreme Weather Events and Consumer Food Responses
title_zh: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应
abstract: This study investigates consumer food responses to Hurricanes Helene and Milton, which affected a swath of the Southeastern U.S. in 2024. Using representative consumer survey data from six affected states, we analyze 10 distinct food responses classified into ex ante and ex post responses, and examine their associations with food insufficiency and diet quality. We find that ex ante food stockpiling is associated with a lower likelihood of food insufficiency and a higher diet quality score. Conversely, the ex post drop in food spending due to income loss is associated with a higher likelihood of food insufficiency and a lower diet quality score. We also examine heterogeneity in food responses across sociodemographic groups. Our results suggest that targeted support for families with children and low‐income households warrant consideration.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2024年影响美国东南部地区的飓风海伦和米尔顿对消费者食品应对行为的影响。基于来自六个受灾州的代表性消费者调查数据，我们将10种不同的食品应对行为分为事前应对和事后应对两类，并分析了它们与食品不足和膳食质量之间的关联。研究发现，事前囤积食品与较低的食品不足发生率和较高的膳食质量评分相关。相反，因收入损失导致的事后食品支出下降则与较高的食品不足发生率和较低的膳食质量评分相关。我们还考察了不同社会人口群体在食品应对行为上的异质性。研究结果表明，针对有子女家庭和低收入家庭的有针对性支持值得考虑。

title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
title_zh: 集体道德风险、风险分担与银行业联盟
abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在政府与银行集体道德风险背景下，跨国风险分担与银行资本要求的最优设计。转移支付虽能提供保险，但会削弱财政纪律。由于宽松的财政政策会加剧银行的风险转移行为，最优支持必须取决于银行体系的健康状况。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机中若银行具备偿付能力，支持力度更大；对于财政强劲的国家，在主权与银行双重危机中支持力度更大，这要求存款保险实现共同化。与无跨国转移支付的情形相比，最优合约设定的资本要求更低，这通过提高主权与银行双重危机的成本来强化财政纪律，并促进更大程度的风险分担。

title: Women Prefer Larger Governments: Growth, Structural Transformation and Government Size
title_zh: 女性偏好更大规模的政府：增长、结构转型与政府规模
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The increase in income per capita is accompanied, in virtually all countries, by two changes in the structure of the economy, namely an increase in the share of government spending in GDP and an increase in female labour force participation. This paper suggests that these two changes are causally related. We develop a growth model where the structure of the economy is endogenous so that participation in market activities and government size are causally related. Economic growth and rising incomes are accompanied by a greater incentive for women to engage in labour market activities as the opportunity cost of staying at home increases. We hypothesize that government spending decreases the cost of performing household chores such as, but not limited to, child rearing and child care so that couples decide to engage further in the labour market and chose a higher tax rate to finance more government spending. Using a wide cross-section of data for developed and developing countries, we show that higher participation by women in the labour market are indeed positively associated with larger governments. Furthermore, we investigate the causal link between the two variables using as instrumental variables a unique and novel dataset on the relative price of home appliances across OECD countries and over time. We find strong evidence of a causal link between participation in the labour market and government size: a 10 percent rise in participation in the labour market leads to a 7 to 8 percent rise in government size. This effect is robust to the country sample, time period, and a set of controls in the spirit of Rodrik (1998). The inclusion of an endogenous choice of government spending allows a considerable extension of the model in Galor and Weil (2000) so fertility can either rise or fall and phenomena like the baby boom and baby bust in Greenwood at el. (2002) can be addressed. In addition, the paper has important implications for the analysis of the secular as well as cross-country determinants of government size.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有国家的人均收入增长都伴随着经济结构的两种变化，即政府支出占GDP比重的上升和女性劳动参与率的提高。本文提出这两种变化存在因果关系。我们构建了一个经济结构内生的增长模型，使市场活动参与度与政府规模形成因果关联。随着经济增长和收入提高，女性因居家机会成本上升而更倾向于参与劳动力市场活动。我们假设政府支出降低了育儿等家务劳动成本，促使家庭选择更高税率以支持更多政府支出，从而进一步参与劳动力市场。基于发达国家与发展中国家的跨国截面数据，我们发现女性劳动参与率提高确实与政府规模扩大呈正相关。进一步地，我们利用OECD国家跨时期家电相对价格这一独特新颖数据集作为工具变量，探究两变量间的因果联系。研究证实劳动参与率与政府规模存在显著因果关系：劳动参与率每提升10%，政府规模将扩大7%-8%。该效应在罗德里克（1998）框架下对样本国家、时间跨度及控制变量组合均保持稳健。通过引入政府支出的内生选择，本文对Galor和Weil（2000）模型进行了重要拓展，使生育率既可上升也可下降，并能解释Greenwood等（2002）提出的婴儿潮与婴儿低谷现象。此外，本研究对分析政府规模的长期趋势及跨国决定因素具有重要启示。
